newsitem.title: USA: Norwest Corp Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Norwest Corp Q3 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 net is after non-recurring charge of $19.0 million pre-tax, or $0.03 per fully diluted share, for SAIF recapitalization assessment.
Q3 1996 earnings before SAIF charge were $300.8 million, or $0.79 per fully diluted share.

Q3 1996 results include net interest income of $947.7 million vs $839.8 million, provision for credit losses of $105.9 million vs $86.5 million, non-interest income of $631.8 million vs $483.7 million, and non-interest expense of $1.03 billion vs $866.2 million.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month 1996 operating results excluding SAIF charge $857.6 million, or $2.29 per fully diluted share.

Nine-month 1996 results include net interest income of $2.76 billion vs $2.38 billion, provision for credit losses of $281.1 million vs $216.5 million, non-interest income of $1.83 billion vs $1.33 billion, and non-interest expenses of $2.99 billion vs $2.45 billion.
